# Tatkraft Marketing

> Marketing engineering for AI search. Tatkraft helps small and mid-sized
> AI-native SaaS companies become visible and cited in AI-driven discovery —
> ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity — as well as traditional search.

## Services
- [SEO Services](https://tatkraft.nz/services/seo): search engine optimisation — the foundation AEO and GEO are built on top of.
- [Content Architecture](https://tatkraft.nz/services/content-architecture): structuring sites and content so AI systems can parse, understand and cite them as a source.
- [Technical Foundations](https://tatkraft.nz/services/technical-foundations): schema, structured data and AI crawler access.
- [Agentic Content Engines](https://tatkraft.nz/services/agentic-content-engines): AI-enabled content production workflows built and handed over as an owned system.
- [AI Tracking / Measurement](https://tatkraft.nz/services/ai-tracking-measurement): tracking visibility and citation across ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews and traditional search.

## About
- [About Jack Flewett](https://tatkraft.nz/about): 20+ years in senior digital growth leadership across global SaaS and AI-native businesses. Positions as a Marketing Engineer.
